THE SPARK

Why this one?

When electronics fail in a place where you cannot simply press restart, the interesting question is what the system can do for itself. ASTRA was a way to test that problem with real hardware.

THE BUILD

How it works

A spacecraft-inspired fault-recovery testbed. A main ESP32 and a supervising ESP32 exchange heartbeats while sensors provide fault signals. The design demonstrates nominal operation, fault detection, payload shutdown, recovery and a return to normal operation.

ESP32 · DS18B20 · Embedded C++ · FastAPI

THE COMPONENTS

Inside the project

  • Two-controller supervisor architecture
  • Heartbeat monitoring and fault-state transitions
  • Temperature sensing and payload recovery experiments
